title: Naturalist reacts: a tiger playing in a pool
storyboard: Film: naturalist in corner inset reacting to the clip (surprise, then explain), green screen, 2 takes

scenes.headline: Yes. Tigers are adept swimmers.
scenes.body: They cope with heat worse than other big cats, which may explain the bathing.

scenes.headline: But check where this is
scenes.body: A captive Bengal-Indochinese hybrid at a tiger park in Thailand. Not how wild tigers live.

scenes.headline: Want wild tigers? Go with a naturalist.
scenes.body: Our tiger-reserve trips watch from safari vehicles, at a distance.

caption:
Cute clip. Here's the context.

Britannica notes tigers evolved in the forests of eastern Asia and tolerate heat less than other big cats, which may be why they bathe.

Source: Britannica; clip description on Wikimedia Commons.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
